prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for most change types (choose_path redesign, finish new_flow, finish notification, home new_flow, home new_screen, sign_in hint, sign_in reorder) as each has only been tested once.
With 2 tests completed for adoption copy changes, results do not yet agree (one won at +4.5% after noise correction, while the other had no clear effect at -0.3%), so evidence remains thin.
No clear effect was seen for home new_flow, home new_screen, finish notification, finish new_flow, sign_in hint, or choose_path redesign changes.
Reordering sign-in performed poorly (-5.2% after noise correction) and was stopped early, but evidence is still thin to form a definitive rule.
Predictions were not consistently too high across all tests: while most tests overestimated impact, predictions underestimated the winning adoption copy change (predicted +0.5% vs +4.5% after noise correction).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: +2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +2.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -5.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_stage_redesign: Redesign the companion selection screen into a stage layout with trait spotlights and visual focus to streamline decisions. (why: Adoption has a 63.6% conversion rate with long median (89s) and mean (1017s) duration, indicating friction during selection.)
1: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_render_checklist: Display a desktop status checklist on the waiting screen to show pet render setup progress. (why: Home step has a high mean wait time (2336s) and support received 3 emails about pets failing to appear on desktop.)
2: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_quality_check_hint: Add visual photo quality hints on the photo upload screen to prevent generation failure. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted renders during adoption.)
3: [home, notification] waiting_screen_completion_notification: Enable system notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation completes. (why: Home wait step takes long median (201s) and mean (2336s) times, causing users to abandon or minimize the app.)
4: [finish, redesign] home_intro_carousel_redesign: Redesign home_intro into a carousel spotlight explaining core interactions and desktop overlay rules. (why: Finish step takes a mean of 5815s with 34.2% drop-off, while users report confusion regarding pet controls post-setup.)
5: [sign_in, layout] sign_in_compact_layout: Switch sign-in to a lightweight compact layout to improve rendering speed and reduce screen load delays. (why: 2 support emails reported sign-in stalling or failing to load, and conversion drops at 72.9%.)

scores.note: High drop-off at adoption stage (36.4%), but redesigns have shown weak results and lack support mail evidence.
Both long wait times in funnel and 3 support emails point directly to missing desktop render status info.
Strong alignment between high adoption drop-off, 3 support tickets, and proven positive lift from hints (+2.4%).
Funnel shows long wait times, but notification features previously showed flat to negative lift (-0.3%).
High drop-off in finish, but complete flow redesigns and finish alterations previously degraded conversion (-2.1%).
Supported by both 72.9% drop-off rate and 2 support tickets regarding sign-in loading failures.
